What You’ll Do: Own the technical roadmap and make sure every engineering effort maps directly to business impact. No features for features’ sake. Lead and grow an engineering team that ships fast, iterates constantly, and treats complexity as a cost. Tackle the hard, multi-layered problem: automated vetting, intelligent matching at scale, demand-side bottlenecks. And figure out where the real leverage is. Make hard prioritization calls. Decide what we build, what we skip, and what we kill. Work directly with the founder and product team to define what success looks like before writing a single line of code. Build the engineering culture: high ownership, high speed, low bureaucracy. Who You Are: Product-minded, business-first Obsessed with simplicity First principles thinker Fast. Bias toward action Experience: You’ve led engineering teams (5–30+ people) at a startup or high-growth company. You have hands-on experience with modern stacks and are comfortable with AI/ML tooling. You’ve worked in a distributed, async-first team. Why Lemon.io : Profitable and growing. No fundraising pressure, real business fundamentals. A pivotal moment: you’re not maintaining an engine, you’re building one. The product roadmap is wide open. Direct access to the founder. No layers. Your decisions ship. A massive, unsolved problem: hiring is still broken. We’re building the product that makes it radically faster for companies to find qualified engineers. A team of 60 people who move fast, care deeply, and have survived the hard years together.

jobs.title: AI Trainer - Video Annotation
jobs.descriptionHtml:
AI Trainer - Video Annotation

Remote   |   Independent Contractor   

Prove your skills. Get certified. 

Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects. 


▌ What you will do

As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to:

  • Annotate short video clips by identifying objects, actions and events.

  • Evaluate video quality, relevance and accuracy against established guidelines.

  • Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements.

  • Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues.

▌ What you bring

  • Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.

  • Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently.

  • A commitment to accuracy and consistency.

  • No previous AI or robotics experience required.

▌ What the work looks like

You may review short videos and be asked to tag objects or actions, rate video clarity or camera angles on a 1 to 10 scale, or assess whether movements are clearly visible and plausible.


Please note:  We currently have three projects open, and completing the certification process will allow us to evaluate which project may be the best fit for you.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

jobs.title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Rails Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

jobs.title: Remote Office Assistant
jobs.descriptionHtml: Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment. As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments. We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement. Why Join Coalition Technologies? Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer: 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance Subsidized gym memberships Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses Office Assistant Responsibilities As an Office Assistant, your duties will include: Answering phones and emails Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars Required Skills and Qualifications The ideal candidate will have: Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole Excellent verbal and written communication skills High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness Strong attention to detail and organizational skills Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers Preferred Skills The following experience is preferred but not required: Intermediate spreadsheet skills Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations Remote Work Environment Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world. Growth Opportunity This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments. Compensation For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Contractor
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.

During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!

Compensation Structure

This role is 100% commission-based, which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.

Training Period (Weeks 1–4)

We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed:

  • Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes).

  • Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most.

    • Week 0: Unpaid

    • Week 1: $100 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 2: $150 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 3: $250 guaranteed minimum

By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.

Post Training Period:

  • Average first year OTE: 25K-35K (US) Annually

  • Top Rep first year OTE: 35K-45K (US) Annually

*The above is the average pay you can expect, however, there is unlimited earning potential for those who are financially motivated top performers looking to exceed sales targets.

What will you be doing?

Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit.

We are looking for team members who are:

  • Tech savvy with the ability to navigate digital tools such as SLACK, CRM software, google sheets, etc. Our team uses these digital tools daily.

  • Growth oriented and always looking to learn and acquire new skills.

  • Autonomous self starters who can work independently and efficiently.

  • Team players with the ability to implement feedback from their sales coaches.

  • Patient and professional with clients. Finances can be a difficult topic for some clients to discuss. We are looking for individuals who showcase empathy and professionalism especially under pressure!

  • Financially motivated individuals who can meet and exceed sales targets.

  • Outgoing with outstanding rapport building and active listening skills. Can you carry a conversation with anyone? This may be for you!

You will need:

  • Home office or a quiet place to work.

  • Strong internet connection.

  • Desktop or laptop

(*Please Note: Devices such as Chromebooks, IPADs and laptops with 8G’s of RAM and under will have issues supporting our system)

Scheduling

Training: The schedule for the first four weeks of our training period is 10 AM - 6 PM EST.

*The first week of training is mandatory for all new trainees. If a day is missed you may be asked to restart the first week of training.

Post Training:

We are currently seeking representatives to work on the following schedule:

Monday - Friday

Shift hours to be discussed with our hiring manager based on our company's needs at the time of hire. Shifts are as follows:

  • 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM EST

  • 8:30 AM - 4:30 PM EST

  • 9:00 AM - 5:00 AM EST

  • 9:30 AM - 5:30 PM EST

  • 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST

  • 10:30 AM - 6:30 PM EST

  • 11:00 AM - 7:00 PM EST

  • 11:30 AM - 7:30 PM EST

  • 12:30 PM - 8:30 PM EST

  • 1:30 PM - 9:30 PM EST

  • 2:30 PM - 10:30 PM EST

  • 3:00 PM - 11:00 PM EST

Job Type: Contract

Shift:

  • 8 hour shift

  • Day shift

  • Evening shift

  • Morning shift

  • Night shift

Supplemental Pay:

  • Bonus opportunities

  • Commission pay

Experience:

  • Sales: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

  • Health & beauty

  • Home Decor
  • Fashion
  • Sports
  • Do it yourself
  • Finance
  • Legal
  • Medical
  • Family/Parenting
  • Relationships
  • Real Estate

jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter
jobs.descriptionHtml:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

 

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

 

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

  • Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
  • Skincare and beauty
  • Tech and software
  • Finance and investing
  • Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  • Education
  • Home improvement
  • Automobiles and motorcycles
  • Health and wellness
  • Medical and clinical fields
  • Digital marketing
  • SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities
  • Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  • Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
  • Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
  • Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
  • Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
  • Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications
  • Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
  • 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
  • Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
  • Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
  • Portfolio featuring published work preferred
  • Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate

 

Application Process

Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you a talented Senior Developer looking for a remote job that lets you show your skills and get decent compensation? Look no further than Lemon.io — the marketplace that connects you with hand-picked startups in the US and Europe.

 

What we offer:

  • The rate depends on your seniority level, skills and experience. We've already paid out over $11M to our engineers.
  • No more hunting for clients or negotiating rates — let us handle the business side of things so you can focus on what you do best.
  • We'll manually find the best project for you according to your skills and preferences.
  • Choose a schedule that works best for you. It’s possible to communicate async or minimally overlap within team working hours.
  • We respect your seniority so you can expect no micromanagement or screen trackers.
  • Communicate directly with the clients. Most of them have technical backgrounds. Sounds good, yeah?
  • We will support you from the time you submit the application throughout all cooperation stages.
  • Most of our projects involve working in a fast-paced startup environment. We hope you like it as much as we do.

 

Requirements for the Senior React & Python Position:
  • 4+ years of software development experience.

Commercial experience:

  • React.js 3+ years & Python 3+ years

    OR
    React.js 2+ years & Python 5+ years
    OR
    React.js 5+ years & Python 2+ years

  • Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure is required.

 

Other requirements:

  • Strong technical skills: as a Senior Developer, you are expected to be able to create projects from scratch and have a deep understanding of application architecture.
  • Clear and effective communication in English — advanced ability to discuss business tasks, justify decisions, and communicate issues. Good self-presentation is also essential for upcoming client calls.
  • Strong self-organizational skills — ability to work full-time remotely with no supervision.
  • Reliability — we want to trust you and expect that you won’t let us and the client down.

NOT YOUR TECH STACK?

  • Du koordinierst Shootings, Videodrehs und Contentproduktionen gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern und Kund:innen.

  • Du steuerst Social-Media-Kampagnen (organisch & paid) und entwickelst kreative Kampagnen und Kommunikationskonzepte.

jobs.title: Operations Manager (m/w/d) für Wärmecontracting
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Wer wir sind

Kola NetZero bringt Eigentümer von Mehrfamilienhäusern mit einem führenden Anbieter für Wärmecontracting zusammen: Der Eigentümer bekommt eine neue, klimafreundliche Heizzentrale ohne eigene Investition, der Anbieter betreibt sie 15 Jahre lang, und wir begleiten den Weg von der ersten Anfrage bis zur Unterschrift. Hinter Kola NetZero steht die Kola Invest GmbH, ein Hamburger Family Office mit Fokus auf Wohnimmobilien.

Wir sind ein kleines Team mit großem Ziel: mehrere tausend Wohneinheiten pro Monat in die Wärmewende zu bringen. Dafür bauen wir gerade das Backoffice auf, das aus eingereichten Objekten vertragsreife Projekte macht. Du bist die erste Person in dieser Rolle und prägst, wie wir arbeiten.

Deine Aufgaben

Du verantwortest den Weg eines Objekts vom Eingang bis zur Freigabe durch den Anbieter. Konkret:

  • Pipeline steuern: 50 bis 100 Objekte gleichzeitig im Prozess halten. Du weißt jederzeit, welches Objekt in welcher Phase steckt, was blockiert und was als Nächstes dran ist, und berichtest das wöchentlich an die Geschäftsführung.

  • Objekteingang prüfen: Energieausweise, Heizkostenabrechnungen, Gasrechnungen und Objektlisten der Eigentümer sichten, Daten in unsere Portfolioliste übertragen und auf Vollständigkeit prüfen.

  • Technischen Fit bewerten: Zentral oder dezentral, Energieträger, Kesselalter, Anzahl Wohneinheiten, Warmwasserbereitung. Du entscheidest mit, welche Objekte an den Anbieter gehen und welche nicht.

  • Vergleichsrechnungen erstellen: Kosten heute gegen Kosten mit Contracting über 15 Jahre (Brennstoff, CO2-Preis, Wartung, Investition) mit unseren Tools aufbereiten und dem Eigentümer erklären können.

  • Beteiligte koordinieren: Eigentümer, Hausverwaltung, Messdienst, Vertrieb und Technik des Anbieters und unsere Vermittlungspartner. Du holst fehlende Unterlagen ein, hältst Fristen nach und vermittelst, wenn es hakt.

  • Übergabe an den Anbieter: Objekte in das gemeinsame Portfolio-Sheet einstellen, Status pflegen, Begehungen koordinieren und den Vertragsprozess bis zur Unterschrift treiben.

  • Partner-Netzwerk abrechnen: Vermittelte Objekte den Partnern zuordnen und Provisionen vorbereiten.

  • Prozesse und Tools aufbauen: Du definierst, wann ein Objekt „vollständig“ und wann es „vertragsreif“ ist, schreibst die Abläufe auf und automatisierst mit Google Sheets, Drive und KI-gestützten Auswertungen, was heute Handarbeit ist.

Dein Profil

Erfahrung

  • Objektmanagement oder Teamleitung in einer größeren Hausverwaltung

  • Operations oder Customer Success in einem PropTech- oder Energie-Startup

  • Projektsteuerung bei Sanierungen und Modernisierungen im Wohnungsbestand

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium, zum Beispiel Immobilienkaufmann/-frau, Versorgungstechnik, Energiewirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder Betriebswirtschaft.

  • Du hältst 80 Bälle gleichzeitig in der Luft, ohne dass einer liegen bleibt, und entscheidest selbst, was Vorrang hat.

jobs.title: Senior Principal ASIC Design Engineer
jobs.descriptionText: <div class="content-intro"><p><span data-teams="true">Astera Labs (NASDAQ: ALAB) provides rack-scale AI infrastructure through purpose-built connectivity solutions. By collaborating with hyperscalers and ecosystem partners, Astera Labs enables organizations to unlock the full potential of modern AI. Astera Labs’ Intelligent Connectivity Platform integrates CXL®, Ethernet, NVLink, PCIe®, and UALink™ semiconductor-based technologies with the company’s COSMOS software suite to unify diverse components into cohesive, flexible systems that deliver end-to-end scale-up, and scale-out connectivity. The company’s custom connectivity solutions business complements its standards-based portfolio, enabling customers to deploy tailored architectures to meet their unique infrastructure requirements. Discover more at <a id="menurhut" class="fui-Link ___1q1shib f2hkw1w f3rmtva f1ewtqcl fyind8e f1k6fduh f1w7gpdv fk6fouc fjoy568 figsok6 f1s184ao f1mk8lai fnbmjn9 f1o700av f13mvf36 f1cmlufx f9n3di6 f1ids18y f1tx3yz7 f1deo86v f1eh06m1 f1iescvh fhgqx19 f1olyrje f1p93eir f1nev41a f1h8hb77 f1lqvz6u f10aw75t fsle3fq f17ae5zn" href="http://www.asteralabs.com/" target="_blank">www.asteralabs.com</a>.</span></p></div><h1><strong>Senior Principal ASIC Design Engineer</strong></h1> <p><strong>Location:</strong> Germany (on-site)</p> <h2><strong>Role Overview</strong></h2> <p>Astera Labs is building purpose-built silicon for rack-scale AI infrastructure. As a Distinguished Engineer, you will be a senior technical leader driving ASIC design for next-generation Ethernet and Scale-Up (ESUN) connectivity products.</p> <p>You will set technical direction across the full ASIC design flow, spanning high-speed Ethernet, UALink, UCIe, and PCIe Gen 6/7. You will solve complex scale-up networking challenges, mentor senior engineers, and turn ambitious product goals into robust, manufacturable silicon.</p> <h2><strong>Technical Leadership &amp; Architecture</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Define and drive ASIC architecture for Ethernet/ESUN connectivity products across UALink, UCIe, PCIe Gen 6/7, and Ethernet.</li> <li>Lead architecture and microarchitecture for high-performance Ethernet controllers, MACs, NIC datapaths, packet processing pipelines, and AI interconnect fabrics.</li> <li>Define scalable, low-latency, high-bandwidth data movement, scheduling, buffering, congestion management, QoS, reliability, and flow control.</li> <li>Architect hardware acceleration for NIC functions, RDMA, DMA, virtualization, and protocol offloads.</li> <li>Lead tradeoff analysis across performance, power, area, latency, scalability, resiliency, and programmability.</li> <li>Serve as a technical authority across digital, networking, and system domains.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>ASIC Design &amp; Execution</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Lead RTL design and microarchitecture development for Ethernet controllers, MACs, NIC datapaths, protocol engines, and AI networking subsystems.</li> <li>Design packet processing architectures, DMA engines, queue management, scheduling, buffering, and memory subsystem interfaces.</li> <li>Develop hardware mechanisms for RDMA, zero-copy data movement, congestion control, transport reliability, and protocol acceleration.</li> <li>Design scalable architectures supporting virtualization, multi-tenant isolation, traffic management, and quality of service.</li> <li>Partner with firmware and software teams to define hardware/software interfaces for initialization, management, telemetry, performance monitoring, and diagnostics.</li> <li>Drive execution from architecture through RTL, integration, verification, tapeout, and post-silicon bring-up.</li> <li>Partner cross-functionally to meet performance, timing, power, area, manufacturability, and reliability targets.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Basic Qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.</li> <li>12+ years of ASIC/SoC design experience, with a track record of delivering complex, high-speed networking or connectivity silicon from architecture through production.</li> <li>Deep expertise in RTL design and microarchitecture for high-performance networking and connectivity ASICs.</li> <li>Extensive experience designing Ethernet controllers, MACs, NIC architectures, packet processing engines, or network interface subsystems.</li> <li>Strong understanding of RDMA architectures and transport protocols such as RoCE, InfiniBand concepts, or similar low-latency networking technologies.</li> <li>Experience designing hardware for packet parsing, scheduling, buffering, DMA, queue management, flow control, congestion management, and transport acceleration.</li> <li>Strong understanding of high-speed interconnects and protocols, including Ethernet, PCIe, and AI scale-up fabrics.</li> <li>Hands-on experience across the complete ASIC development flow, including architecture, RTL design, integration, synthesis, timing closure, physical implementation, tapeout, and post-silicon validation.</li> <li>Demonstrated technical leadership across multiple teams and product programs.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.</li> <li>Direct experience with UALink, UCIe, PCIe Gen 6/7, and/or advanced Ethernet architectures and protocols.</li> <li>Experience designing Ethernet MACs, controllers, SmartNICs, DPUs, NICs, switch datapaths, or packet processing engines.</li> <li>Experience developing Ethernet-based scale-up networking solutions for AI and HPC systems.</li> <li>Experience leading architecture or design for multiple successful advanced-node ASIC tapeouts.</li> <li>Excellent communication, collaboration, and mentorship skills.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>We know that creativity and innovation happen more often when teams include diverse ideas, backgrounds, and experiences, and we actively encourage everyone with relevant experience to apply, including people of color, LGBTQ+ and non-binary people, veterans, parents, and individuals with disabilities.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.descriptionText: <p><strong>Mission Brief&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>You will own the engine cycle and the top level technical architecture of a pump fed liquid rocket engine. jobs.title: Director, Customer Compensation & Policy
jobs.descriptionText: <h2>About the Role&nbsp;</h2> <p>Within Global Customer Experience (GCX), our mission is to advance the HelloFresh customer relationship from reactive resolution to proactive, trust-building service. The compensation function sits at the heart of that mission: it is the mechanism through which the business acknowledges failures, restores customer confidence, and, when done well, turns a bad experience into a reason to stay.</p> <p>The Associate Director, Customer Compensation &amp; Policy is responsible for the global strategy, architecture, and governance of how HelloFresh compensates customers across all markets and brands. This is not a policy maintenance role. It is a strategic function that sits at the intersection of customer economics, operational data, behavioral experimentation, and cross-functional influence.</p> <p>You will own one of the most financially material and customer-sensitive levers in the business. You will shape a multi-year roadmap and hold peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market Leadership accountable for the quality of inputs that determine how well and how efficiently we recover customer trust.</p> <p><em>The ideal candidate brings a rare combination: analytical rigor sharp enough to architect a global compensation engine from first principles, and the executive presence to drive adoption across a complex, multi-market organization without formal authority over most of the people they need to move.</em></p> <h2>What You'll Own&nbsp;</h2> <p><strong>&nbsp;Global Compensation Strategy &amp; Engine Architecture</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end strategic vision for how HelloFresh categorizes customer errors and determines compensation across all markets, brands, and contact channels.</li> <li>Lead the design and continuous evolution of the compensation engine: along with Tech, you’ll define the the rules, thresholds, segmentation logic, and automation frameworks that govern recovery decisions at scale.</li> <li>Define the principles that govern trade-offs between customer generosity and cost discipline and translate those principles into operational rules that hold across market complexity and brand variation.</li> <li>Partner with Technology to ensure the compensation engine is scalable, auditable, and capable of supporting dynamic, AI-assisted decisioning as the product evolves.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experimentation &amp; Behavioral Economics</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set the global roadmap for compensation experimentation: A/B testing across offer types, value levels, channel timing, and segmentation variables.</li> <li>Apply behavioral economics frameworks to compensation design understanding how recovery offers shape long-term retention, repurchase behavior, and brand perception, not just immediate satisfaction.</li> <li>Define the measurement framework for experimentation: what constitutes a successful test, what confidence warrants global rollout, and how results are synthesized into durable policy change.</li> <li>Partner with Analytics &amp; Insights to ensure test design, sample integrity, and rollout analysis meet a rigorous standard of evidence.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Stewardship &amp; Cost Governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the global compensation P&amp;L line: tracking spend by market, error category, customer segment, and channel — and holding yourself accountable to defined cost-per-incident and avoidable-contact targets.</li> <li>Identify and close financial leakage: cases where compensation is being issued without policy justification, at incorrect values, or at the wrong frequency.</li> <li>Build the reporting infrastructure that makes compensation economics visible to GCX leadership, market GMs, and Finance — with the granularity and context needed to drive decisions.</li> <li>Define the right balance between cost optimization and customer lifetime value investment: not just 'spend less' but 'spend where it earns back.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Fraud Policy &amp; Global Governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the global fraud and abuse prevention framework: the policies, detection logic, thresholds, and escalation paths that protect the business without creating friction for genuine customers.</li> <li>Lead the governance rhythm for policy: quarterly reviews, market exception management, escalation adjudication, and framework versioning across a multi-brand, multi-market environment.</li> <li>Act as the final authority on complex, cross-market policy gaps — resolving ambiguity with speed, consistency, and strategic clarity rather than routing decisions upward by default.</li> <li>Maintain global standards while creating principled space for market-level adaptation where local context genuinely requires it.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership &amp; Stakeholder Accountability</strong></p> <ul> <li>Represent the compensation function in senior forums translating customer economics into requirements that peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market GMs must respond to.</li> <li>Hold cross-functional partners accountable for the upstream data quality, operational accuracy, and system reliability that the compensation engine depends on.</li> <li>Drive adoption of policy changes across markets and brands, building communication and change management plans that make new frameworks land — not just launch.</li> <li>Influence at VP and Director level across multiple functions; escalate only strategic blockers, not routine alignment.</li> </ul> <h2>What You'll Bring&nbsp;</h2> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <ul> <li>MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification required.</li> <li>Undergraduate degree in Economics, Business, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>8–12 years of progressive experience in customer strategy, pricing, operations, or a directly adjacent domain with meaningful exposure to global, multi-market environments.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of owning a financially significant operational lever and managing it with both analytical precision and strategic judgment.</li> <li>Prior experience leading and developing teams; comfort operating as a senior individual contributor and a people leader simultaneously.</li> <li>Background in subscription commerce, logistics, or consumer-facing operations strongly preferred. Familiarity with the economics of customer recovery in high-volume, low-margin environments is a distinct advantage.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical &amp; Analytical</strong></p> <ul> <li>Advanced proficiency in SQL and data analysis; able to build and pressure-test the analytical models that underpin policy decisions without delegating the logic to others.</li> <li>Fluency with experimentation methodology: test design, statistical significance, holdout analysis, and the translation of results into policy not just reporting.</li> <li>Experience working with or alongside engineering teams to define product and system requirements for rules-based or AI-assisted decisioning tools.</li> <li>Comfort with financial modeling: building the business case for compensation investment, forecasting spend impact, and tracking actuals against plan.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Leadership &amp; Influence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Senior executive presence: able to walk into a GM, COO, or CFO conversation with a clear point of view, defend it under pressure, and leave with alignment.</li> <li>A credible voice with peers and upward stakeholders not because of title, but because of the quality of analysis and clarity of communication.</li> <li>Structured and decisive under ambiguity: able to make a defensible call with incomplete information and adjust as evidence develops.</li> <li>Genuinely collaborative across markets and functions able to hold people to standards without damaging the relationships needed to sustain them.</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer</h2> <ul> <li><em>Modern and comfortable working space with great co-workers in Berlin-Kreuzberg</em></li> <li><em>Discount for HelloFresh boxes and Convini products</em></li> <li><em>Development possibilities along with internal trainings and a yearly Learning &amp; Development budget</em></li> <li><em>Flexible working hours including Work From Home/Work from Abroad/Sabbatical Policy, as well as a home office set up budget&nbsp;</em></li> <li><em>Extensive Onboarding and Buddy Program</em></li> <li><em>Social events including team events, Friday beers, company runs, book club, etc.</em></li> <li><em>Discounted fitness offers with our Urban Sports Club and John Reed partners and yoga classes</em></li> <li><em>Well-being initiatives in cooperation with Headspace and Spill</em></li> <li><em>Childcare and company pension scheme benefit</em></li> <li><em>Monthly transportation budget via NAVIT</em></li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <p style="text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p> <p style="text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Ph.D. Researcher. Knowledge Discovery: From Unstructured Data to Shared Cognitive Maps
jobs.descriptionText: <h3>Constructor University in collaboration with Constructor Knowledge Labs and Constructor Technology</h3> <hr> <h3>About the Position</h3> <p>The research group led by Prof. Dr. Andrey Ustyuzhanin at Constructor University, in collaboration with Constructor Knowledge Labs (CKL) and Constructor Technology (industry partner), invites applications for Ph.D. student positions in the field of Computer Science, with a focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML).</p> <p>This PhD position is part of an initiative to advance knowledge representation and adaptive reasoning systems. The research will focus on developing flexible frameworks for actionable knowledge representation that support storage, retrieval, and dynamic adaptation of information across diverse tasks.</p> <h2><strong>Key objectives include:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Transforming unstructured data into interactive knowledge graphs and personalized cognitive maps.</li> <li>Designing models that provide interpretable, persistent, and navigable structures of knowledge.</li> <li>Addressing challenges such as hierarchy, composability, and coarse-graining for robust, task-specific reasoning.</li> <li>Exploring individual and community-level knowledge modeling, including personalized domain maps, profile extraction from artifacts (e.g., papers, courses), and cross-domain abstraction.</li> </ul> <p>The overarching goal is to create systems that enable <strong>transparent, adaptive, and spatially intuitive representations of knowledge</strong>, supporting both individual users and collaborative communities.</p> <hr> <h3>Applicant Profile</h3> <h2>Mandatory requirements:</h2> <ul> <li>Holding recognized MSc degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related discipline.</li> <li>Students holding BSc degree and exhibiting outstanding performance and extraordinary potential can apply for fast-track PhD.</li> <li>Strong mathematical background supported with experience in defining and developing knowledge-graph or information retrieval systems.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs) and their applications.</li> <li>A track record of publications in AI/ML or related areas.</li> <li>Documented experience in practical research work.</li> <li>Strong skills in academic English writing (peer-reviewed papers, reports, or equivalent).</li> </ul> <hr> <h2>Funding &amp; Appointment Terms</h2> <p>The appointment provides full financial coverage through a dedicated fellowship, comprising:</p> <ul> <li>Monthly stipend of €1,650</li> <li>Monthly research-cost allowance of €100 (Forschungskostenpauschale)</li> <li>Health-insurance subsidy of €100 per month</li> <li>Supplementary €550 mini-job allowance to support parallel part-time employment (optional)</li> </ul> <h3>Application Details</h3> <ul> <li>Expected start date: September<span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">, 2026</span></li> </ul> <h3>Application package must include: </h3> <ul> <li>Curriculum Vitae (CV);</li> <li>Academic transcripts ;</li> <li>A detailed letter of motivation outlining research interests and career goals;</li> <li>2 recommendation letters;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Applications to be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisted candidates </strong>will be invited to interviews.</p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Apaleo and the role

Apaleo is hiring a senior Product Manager to own one product crew end to end, with real autonomy over what gets built and why.

At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers.

Your crew covers the daily workflows every hotel on Apaleo relies on: reservations and groups, guest and company profiles, front desk operations, folios and charges, finance and accounting, and reporting. You'll own the crew's strategy, discovery, prioritisation and delivery, working closely with Engineering and Design, and in step with the Product Manager who owns the wider product direction across crews.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You won't receive a roadmap and execute it. You'll shape it, using customer insight, data and sound reasoning, and you'll stay close to delivery, because shipping reliable improvements is still the core of the job. The role has no people management and covers a single crew.

What you'll be up to

  • Owning your crew's product strategy, roadmap, backlog and delivery within the agreed wider product direction, and measuring success by customer and operational outcomes rather than items shipped.
  • Running customer discovery: interviewing users, reaching out to customers, spotting patterns across them and studying how competitors and the wider market solve the same problem.
  • Writing clear specs, defining what done looks like and following through with impact analysis.
  • Reviewing and challenging designs against real business use cases, together with your Designer.
  • Working shoulder to shoulder with Engineering on technical trade-offs, dependencies, quality, reliability and maintainability, going deep on our API-first architecture.
  • Balancing roadmap initiatives with operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and saying no to good ideas that aren't great ones.
  • Defining success measures for your initiatives, then using customer feedback, product data and operational signals to judge impact and decide what comes next.
  • Communicating progress, risks and trade-offs clearly to Engineering, customer-facing teams and product peers.
  • Bringing your customers' needs, evidence and recommendations into wider product planning, and challenging existing assumptions where the evidence supports it.
  • Spotting dependencies with neighbouring crews and product areas early, and resolving them together so customers get coherent end-to-end workflows.
  • Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering. Around 90% of our team's code is already written with tools like Claude Code, Cursor and GitHub Copilot.

What you'll bring

You have 5+ years as a Product Manager, including 3+ years owning a B2B or API-first product area, and you've run that area with limited day-to-day direction.

Required experience and competencies

  • Independent product ownership. You've owned a product area from problem discovery and prioritisation through to delivery and measuring outcomes. You can tell us which decisions were yours and what you chose not to do.
  • Customer centricity and sharp product judgement. You know how to run interviews, validate assumptions, bring in competitor and market insight, and turn patterns in customer pain points into clear opportunities. Customer centricity is central to this role.
  • Technical depth. You can go deep on API architecture with engineers, challenge their thinking constructively and turn technical constraints into product decisions.
  • Strong execution and prioritisation. You can turn a focused roadmap into an actionable backlog, balance competing demands and keep delivery moving whilst protecting quality and long-term value.
  • Platform thinking. You weigh individual customer needs against reusable capabilities, API consistency, integration requirements and the long-term evolution of a shared platform.
  • Clear stakeholder alignment. You bring Engineering, customer-facing teams and product peers together, manage cross-crew dependencies and communicate trade-offs and decisions with confidence.
  • An outcome mindset. You define meaningful success measures, write specs with a clear definition of done and use impact analysis to guide your next decisions.
  • Autonomy and adaptability. You take ownership, use sound judgement, raise risks early and adapt to changing priorities without needing detailed direction.

Nice to have

  • Direct ownership of a platform or API product with external consumers or integrations.
  • Experience with developer experience, third-party integrations or platform ecosystems.
  • Hospitality, PMS or hotel operations experience.
  • Experience in transactional or finance-adjacent domains such as bookings, payments, billing, invoicing or accounting, where data integrity, consistency and correctness matter.
  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted engineering workflows and using AI in your own PM work.

Don't tick every box? A strong B2B SaaS Product Manager from another domain, with technical depth and a real discovery habit, can be a better fit than a hospitality specialist without them. We'd still love to hear from you.

 

What we offer

Culture and growth

  • A diverse and international team. Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique perspectives and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.
  • Growth and development. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility.
  • Autonomy and ownership. Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly, in an environment built on trust and transparency.
  • Shape the future of hospitality tech. From day one, your work drives real impact and you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.
  • Competitive and fair compensation. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams.

Perks and lifestyle

  • Flexible and remote work options. We focus on results, not clocking hours. Work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup.
  • Free public transport. Travel across Germany with a fully covered Deutschlandticket.
  • Team connection. Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events.
  • Paid time off. 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired.
  • Health and wellbeing. Access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.

Joining Apaleo

Joining Apaleo means more than taking on a role. It's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your work will directly shape our platform, influence company-wide decisions and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued and your impact is tangible.

Apaleo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data is handled with care and in line with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations.

jobs.title: Regional Operations Director-Based in Munich/Berlin
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Indie Campers is the leading campervan marketplace, on a mission to make road trips accessible to everyone. With a fully digital booking experience and a customer-first approach, we have welcomed more than 300,000 travellers from 170 countries and delivered over one million nights on the road. We offer short-term RV rentals, long-term campervan subscriptions, and the option to buy one of our vehicles.

We are a fast-growing, technology-driven company, and our challenges are both exciting and demanding. We are looking for top talent to help build the future of road travel.

The Role

As Regional Operations Director, you lead local operations across a group of countries. Each depot has Operations Supervisors on the floor; clusters of depots are led by Operations Managers; the Operations Managers report to you. You report to the EMEA Operations Vice President.

You will own results on fleet availability and quality, Customer satisfaction and public profile, operational efficiency and profitability, ensuring high service standards and consistent execution of the central procedures and SOPs defined for our operating model.

You will sit on the regional management team alongside peers from Revenue & Growth, People and Finance, and you will be accountable for your region's operational targets and for the operational cost of the service delivered to our customers. 

What You Will Work On

Leadership and performance

  • Lead, coach and develop the regional team and the Depot Leaders across your locations
  • Oversee day-to-day regional operations and drive the region's results on fleet availability, customer satisfaction and profitability
  • Monitor KPIs daily, follow up on action plans and implement improvements
  • Ensure operating standards and SOPs are followed consistently across all depots
  • Safety, legal compliance and audit readiness at every site, under several sets of national law.

Customer first

  • Customer satisfaction and recurring issues across every country in your district, with corrective plans that actually close

P&L and cost ownership

  • Own the regional P&L from an operational standpoint, including budgeting and cost control
  • Identify and deploy efficiency initiatives
  • Keep resources aligned with activity levels, expanding and contracting cost structure based on seasonality
  • Manage relationships with international suppliers serving the region

Collaboration and growth

  • Work closely with Central Ops, Revenue & Growth, Finance, People & Talent Acquisition, and so that processes are well defined and adapted to your region
  • Lead, coordinate and deliver projects related to operational expansion in the region
  • Travel frequently to support depot teams (up to 75% of the time)

Who We Are Looking For

Must have

  • Degree in Engineering, Business Management or a similar field (higher education)
  • 10 years or more of operational leadership in mobility, logistics, hospitality, rental or multi-site management, including several years running operations in more than one country.
  • You have run a profit and loss account of meaningful size and are comfortable owning a commercial result rather than contributing to one.
  • You manage through managers who themselves manage managers. Your effectiveness depends on your Operations Managers being good, not on you being everywhere.
  • You can diagnose across a portfolio and across borders, telling apart a problem with one depot, one manager, one country, or the way we operate.
  • You have worked inside more than one employment-law regime and know where local practice genuinely constrains a standard and where it is being used as an excuse.
  • You make sound people decisions at Supervisor and Manager level in reasonable time, and build a pipeline rather than filling vacancies.
  • You handle capital decisions with finance, and can flex a cost base seasonally across several labour markets without letting service or safety slip.
  • You get results through functions that do not report to you. In this structure that is not a nice-to-have: fleet, revenue, customer experience, people and finance all hold things you need and none of them are yours.
  • You treat safety and compliance as yours, at the same standard at your smallest depot as at your largest.
  • You protect the integrity of what gets reported, and would rather receive a bad number that is true than a good one that is not.
  • You are steady in a crisis and willing to be in the field: every country monthly, a frontline shift monthly, present when it matters.
  • Strong Excel or Sheets. Fluent English and at least one other language used in your district. Full driving licence, category B. Free to travel across your countries without restriction.

Nice to have

  • Multi-country general management in rental, logistics, hospitality or retail, rather than single-market experience repeated.
  • A strongly seasonal business, or one where the asset is the product.
  • Experience of a structure where the functions you depend on report elsewhere.
  • Opening new markets, integrating an acquisition, or setting up a new operating model rather than inheriting a settled one.
  • A third language used in your region

The Indie Commitment

  • A fast-growing, dynamic environment where you make a real impact
  • Career growth in Field Operations, with potential moves to Lisbon, Mexico City or Manila
  • Continuous training and coaching
  • Free road trips across Europe, North America and Oceania

Are you ready to Go Indie?

jobs.title: Global Investigator (EMEA)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As a Global Investigator on the triage team, you will be the first line of operational defense in a fast-moving crypto disruption pipeline. You will process inbound complaint data, validate outputs from our artificial-intelligence (AI) investigation platform, and route cases into the investigative pipelines that result in frozen scam proceeds and seized assets. You will hold the disposition pen: your call is what turns a complaint into a freeze, a takedown, a recovery handoff, a legal-process draft, a victim notification, or a close.

The impact you will have:

  • Validate and route hundreds of complaint dispositions per week, feeding a live asset-recovery pipeline.

  • Catch the AI errors that matter, such as false positives, merged syndicates, and misclassified scam patterns, before they propagate downstream.

  • Enrich complaint selectors using a stack of more than forty commercial data-source integrations.

  • Take the highest-priority complaints beyond disposition: trace funds through consolidation wallets to regulated exchanges or other actionable endpoints

  • Own clean shift handoffs so the around-the-clock operation never drops a lead, providing EMEA-hours coverage that keeps the queue moving while colleagues in other regions are offline.

What we’re looking for:

  • 4 or more years of investigative or analytical experience in the public or private sector, including hands-on blockchain analysis.

  • Demonstrated experience tracing funds across chains and attributing addresses to real-world actors, including the judgment to tell an unattributed service from a privately controlled (unhosted) wallet

  • Experience building or contributing to cases that led to a freeze, seizure, arrest, or takedown.

  • Strong AI fluency, meaning comfort using AI tools as a daily co-pilot, plus the judgment to know when they are wrong.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, fluid environment where the project's scope and emphasis may shift quarter to quarter.

  • Strong written and verbal communication.

About the Team:

  • The team is built around a mix of seasoned investigators and rising talent. Triage investigators sit alongside experienced crypto tracers and intelligence-trained individual contributors.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Daily schedule: standard business hours in your local time zone.

  • Collaboration: coordinate with global teammates for handoffs on time-sensitive items, giving the wider operation near follow-the-sun coverage.

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • Formal on-call rotation for high-priority events, such as hacks, law-enforcement support, and other time-sensitive matters.

  • Weekly rotation, with occasional weekend coverage as needed.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • React quickly to incoming complaint surges and live takedown events.

  • Continuously learn new patterns in crypto-enabled crime.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

jobs.title: Event Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

As Event Manager, you will be Proxima Fusion in Munich, you will plan and deliver events ranging from investor dinners and international conferences to community engagement, exhibitions and team retreats. Your will translate strategic briefs into effective event formats and independently manage delivery, from planning and budgets, to on-site production and follow-up.

This is a hands-on role combining creative judgment,meticulous project management and team spirit. You will bring event expertise to the table, advise internal stakeholders on what will work and take responsibility for turning plans into successful experiences.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Events achieve the objectives agreed with each team and provide a considered, professional experience with Proxima for our guests and stakeholders.

  • Delivery stays on schedule and within agreed budgets, with risks, dependencies and changes managed early.

  • A coordinated event portfolio gives teams visibility of upcoming activity and resource needs, while evaluation and lessons learned improve future delivery.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Translate event objectives, audiences and content briefs into strong formats, detailed delivery plans and well-designed guest experiences.

  • Independently manage events, including timelines, budgets, venues, suppliers, logistics, invitations, production, run-of-show, on-site execution and follow-up.

  • Deliver events involving investors, policymakers, industrial partners, media and other external stakeholders. These may include executive dinners, partner meetings, or events at our offices.
